1.name: Season 1
Aluminum Foil, Snowboards, Contact Lenses, Bread
1.overview: The series premiere follows the transformation of aluminum into extremely thin household foil, the layered construction and finishing of snowboards, the precision molding of soft contact lenses, and the mixing, proofing and baking of commercial bread.

2.name: Compact Discs, Mozzarella Cheese, Pantyhose, Fluorescent Tubes
2.overview: Manufacturing processes include encoding and molding compact discs, turning milk into mozzarella cheese, knitting exceptionally fine synthetic fibers into pantyhose, and assembling fluorescent tubes with phosphor coatings, electrodes and gas.

3.name: Toothpicks, Acrylic Bathtubs, Helicopters, Beer
3.overview: The episode demonstrates how timber is sliced and shaped into toothpicks, acrylic sheets are heated and vacuum-formed into bathtubs, helicopters are assembled and tested, and grain, hops, yeast and water are brewed into beer.

4.name: Hearing Aids, 3D Puzzles, Rubber Mats, Toilets
4.overview: Miniature electronic components are fitted into custom hearing aids, printed designs are cut and assembled into three-dimensional puzzles, rubber is processed into durable floor mats, and vitreous china is molded, glazed and fired to produce toilets.

5.name: Copy Paper, Jeans, Computers, Plate Glass
5.overview: Wood pulp is refined and rolled into copy paper, denim is cut and sewn into jeans, electronic components are installed and tested in personal computers, and molten raw materials are formed into smooth sheets of plate glass.

6.name: Nails and Staples, Safety Glasses, Fabrics, Bicycles
6.overview: Steel wire is cut and shaped into nails and staples, impact-resistant lenses and frames become safety glasses, yarn is woven or knitted into fabric, and bicycle frames and components are assembled into finished cycles.

7.name: Kayaks, Safety Boots, Electronic Signs, Cereals
7.overview: The program examines the molding and outfitting of kayaks, construction of reinforced safety boots, assembly and programming of electronic signs, and large-scale preparation, cooking and packaging of breakfast cereal.

8.name: Trucks, Adhesive Bandages, Computer Circuit Boards, Liquors
8.overview: Heavy truck chassis, engines, cabs and bodies are brought together on an assembly line; absorbent pads and adhesive strips become bandages; conductive pathways and components are added to printed circuit boards; and fermented ingredients are distilled and matured into liquor.

9.name: Steel, Apple Juice, Aircraft Landing Gear, Cosmetics
9.overview: Raw materials are melted and processed into steel, apples are cleaned and pressed into juice, high-strength components are machined and assembled into aircraft landing gear, and pigments, oils and waxes are blended into cosmetics.

10.name: Holograms, Package Printing, Skin Culture, Canned Corn
10.overview: Laser-recorded interference patterns are used to create holograms, high-speed presses print packaging materials, laboratory techniques grow replacement skin tissue, and corn is harvested, prepared, sealed and sterilized for canning.

11.name: Plastic Bags, Solar Panels, Plastic Fuel Tanks, Hockey Sticks
11.overview: Plastic film is extruded, cut and sealed into bags; photovoltaic cells are connected and laminated into solar panels; durable polymers are molded into vehicle fuel tanks; and layered materials are shaped and finished into hockey sticks.

12.name: Aluminum Screw Caps, Chocolate, Pills, Pasta
12.overview: Aluminum sheet is stamped and threaded into bottle caps, cocoa ingredients are refined and tempered into chocolate, pharmaceutical compounds are measured and compressed into pills, and flour-and-water dough is mixed and formed into pasta.

13.name: Bicycle Helmets, Aluminum, Automotive Brakes, Lithium-Ion Batteries
13.overview: Expanded foam and protective shells are combined into bicycle helmets, aluminum is extracted and processed into usable metal, friction components and hydraulic parts become automotive braking systems, and precisely layered materials are assembled into rechargeable lithium-ion batteries.

2.name: Season 2

1.name: Eyeglass Lenses, Granite, Potato Chips, Microprocessors
1.overview: The manufacturing processes behind prescription eyeglass lenses, finished granite products, mass-produced potato chips and microscopic computer processors are examined.

2.name: Honey, Fiber-Optics, Bricks, Pipe Organs
2.overview: Bees and beekeepers produce and harvest honey, glass is drawn into extremely fine optical fibers, clay is molded and fired into bricks, and thousands of specialized components are assembled into pipe organs.

3.name: Personal Watercraft, Wine, Office Furniture, Ice Skates
3.overview: Personal watercraft are molded and mechanically assembled, grapes are fermented and aged into wine, particleboard is transformed into office furniture, and shaped steel blades are fitted to ice-skate boots.

4.name: Winter Jackets, Animation, Mushrooms, Gold Rings
4.overview: Insulated materials are cut and sewn into winter jackets, drawings are developed into animated sequences, mushrooms are cultivated under controlled conditions, and gold alloys are formed and polished into rings.

5.name: Hydroponic Lettuce, Construction Wood, Recycling, Fishing Flies
5.overview: Lettuce is grown without soil in a hydroponic system, logs are processed into construction lumber, discarded materials are sorted and prepared for reuse, and feathers and fibers are tied into artificial fishing flies.

6.name: Diamond Cutting, Wood Doors, Paintballs, Newspapers
6.overview: Rough diamonds are evaluated and precisely cut, lumber is shaped and joined into wooden doors, gelatin shells are filled to create paintballs, and news pages are printed and assembled at high speed.

7.name: Carpets, Drinking Water, Laser Eye Surgery, Acoustic Guitars
7.overview: Yarn is tufted and finished into carpet, municipal water is filtered and disinfected, lasers are used to reshape the eye during corrective surgery, and selected woods are fashioned into acoustic guitars.

8.name: Fiberglass Boats, Clothes Dryers, Bubble Gum, Fireworks
8.overview: Fiberglass layers are molded into boat hulls, metal cabinets and rotating drums become clothes dryers, gum base is mixed and flavored to make bubble gum, and pyrotechnic compounds are assembled into fireworks.

9.name: Steel Safes, False Teeth, Airplanes, Maple Syrup
9.overview: Reinforced steel is fabricated into security safes, dental impressions are used to create fitted dentures, aircraft structures and systems are assembled, and maple sap is collected and concentrated into syrup.

10.name: Gummies, Aluminum Cans, Fish Farming, Bronze Sculptures
10.overview: Gelatin mixtures are molded into gummy candies, aluminum sheet is formed into beverage cans, fish are raised in controlled aquaculture facilities, and artists use molds and molten metal to cast bronze sculptures.

11.name: Aluminum Pots and Pans, Artificial Limbs, Peanut Butter, High Intensity Light Bulbs
11.overview: Aluminum is pressed and finished into cookware, prosthetic limbs are designed and fitted to individual patients, roasted peanuts are ground into peanut butter, and specialized components are assembled into high-intensity light bulbs.

12.name: Cars, Grocery Carts, Rapid Tooling and Prototyping, Collectible Coins
12.overview: Automobile bodies and mechanical components come together on an assembly line, steel wire is shaped into grocery carts, computer-assisted techniques create rapid prototypes and tooling, and commemorative designs are struck into collectible coins.

13.name: Ball Bearings, Electrical Wires, Lost Wax Process Casting, Automated Machines
13.overview: Steel components are ground and polished into precision ball bearings, conductive metal is drawn and insulated to produce electrical wire, wax models are used to cast complex metal objects, and a compilation examines automated manufacturing machinery.

3.name: Season 3

1.name: Pre-Inked Stamps, Cranberries, Cotton Yarn, Road Signs
1.overview: The episode examines how self-inking rubber stamps are manufactured, cranberries are harvested and processed, cotton fibers are spun into yarn, and durable road signs are printed and finished.

2.name: Combination Locks, Pottery, Recreational Vehicles, Erasers
2.overview: Metal components are assembled into combination locks, clay is shaped and fired into pottery, recreational vehicles are constructed and outfitted, and rubber compounds are formed into erasers.

3.name: Wheel Loaders, Vegetable Oil, Hand Tools, Cotton Swabs
3.overview: Heavy components are assembled into wheel loaders, seeds are pressed and refined into vegetable oil, steel is shaped into hand tools, and cotton is attached to paper stems to produce cotton swabs.

4.name: Temporary Metal Fences, Asphalt Shingles, Expanded Polystyrene Products, Hard Candies
4.overview: Steel tubing and wire are fabricated into temporary fencing, asphalt and mineral materials become roofing shingles, expanded polystyrene is molded into lightweight products, and cooked sugar is formed into hard candies.

5.name: Horse-drawn Carriages, Artificial Eyes, Dog and Cat Food, Mirrors
5.overview: Wood and metal are crafted into horse-drawn carriages, prosthetic eyes are individually shaped and painted, ingredients are processed into pet food, and sheets of glass receive reflective coatings to become mirrors.

6.name: Yogurt, Candles, Neon Signs, Bookbindings
6.overview: Bacterial cultures transform milk into yogurt, wax is molded into candles, glass tubes are bent and filled with gas to make neon signs, and printed pages are assembled into bound books.

7.name: Prepared Mustard, Violins, Nuts and Bolts, Toilet Paper
7.overview: Mustard seeds are ground and blended into prepared mustard, selected woods are shaped into violins, steel is formed and threaded into nuts and bolts, and recycled paper pulp is converted into toilet paper.

8.name: Fresh Cut Flowers, Adhesive Tape, Tofu, Lottery Tickets
8.overview: Flowers are harvested and prepared for commercial sale, adhesive is applied to backing material to produce tape, soybeans are processed into tofu, and security printing techniques are used to manufacture lottery tickets.

9.name: Inflatable Watercraft, Couscous, Modelling Dough, Wicker Products
9.overview: Coated fabric is cut and sealed into inflatable boats, semolina is formed into couscous, flour and other ingredients are blended into modeling dough, and flexible plant materials are woven into wicker products.

10.name: Wind Generators, PVC Gloves, Thermo-formed Glass, Fire Trucks
10.overview: Large mechanical and electrical components are assembled into wind generators, polyvinyl chloride is formed into protective gloves, heated glass is shaped in molds, and specialized equipment is installed on fire trucks.

11.name: Car Radiators, Hatchery Chicks, Phyllo Dough, Cross-Country Skis
11.overview: Metal tubes and fins are assembled into automotive radiators, fertilized eggs are incubated and hatched, pastry dough is stretched into extremely thin sheets, and layered materials are shaped into cross-country skis.

12.name: Electric Baseboard Heaters, Molded Pulp Containers, Prepared Chicken, Video Games
12.overview: Heating elements are enclosed in electric baseboard units, recycled paper pulp is molded into packaging containers, chickens are processed and prepared for sale, and computer graphics and programming are combined to create video games.

13.name: Firefighter Boots, Garden Tools, Automated Machines, Gypsum Board
13.overview: Protective materials are assembled into firefighter boots, steel is forged and fitted with handles to make garden tools, automated manufacturing equipment is demonstrated, and gypsum plaster is enclosed between paper layers to produce wallboard.

4.name: Season 4

1.name: Plastic Bottles and Jars, Mail, Eggs, Handcrafted Wooden Pens
1.overview: Plastic is heated and formed into bottles and jars, letters and parcels are processed through an automated postal facility, eggs are collected, inspected and packaged, and selected woods are turned and finished into handcrafted pens.

2.name: Plastic Injection Moulds, Automotive Oil Filters, Filing Cabinets, Blown Glass
2.overview: Precision metal tooling is machined into plastic injection moulds, filter media and metal components are assembled into automotive oil filters, sheet steel is cut and formed into filing cabinets, and molten glass is shaped by hand using traditional glassblowing techniques.

3.name: High-Precision Cutting Tools, Stained Glass, Semi-Trailers, Recorders
3.overview: Hard industrial materials are shaped and sharpened into high-precision cutting tools, colored glass is cut and joined into stained-glass panels, structural components are assembled into semi-trailers, and wood or plastic is bored and finished to make recorders.

4.name: Conga Drums, Metal Plating, Buttons
4.overview: Wooden staves are joined and fitted with hardware and drumheads to make conga drums, objects receive decorative or protective metallic coatings through electroplating, and a range of materials is molded, drilled and polished into buttons.

5.name: Grinding Wheels, Compost, Window Blinds, Milk
5.overview: Abrasive grains and bonding materials are pressed and fired into grinding wheels, organic waste is decomposed and processed into compost, slats and operating mechanisms are assembled into window blinds, and raw milk is tested, pasteurized and packaged.

6.name: Brushes and Push Brooms, Blackboards, Smoked Salmon, Zippers
6.overview: Bristles are inserted and secured in handles and blocks to produce brushes and push brooms, smooth writing surfaces are manufactured into blackboards, salmon is cured and smoked, and interlocking teeth are attached to fabric tape to make zippers.

7.name: 3D Commercial Signs, Hardwood Floors, Corrugated Polyethylene Pipe, Mattresses
7.overview: Plastic and metal are cut and formed into three-dimensional commercial signs, hardwood is dried, milled and finished into flooring, molten polyethylene is extruded into corrugated pipe, and springs, foam and fabric are assembled into mattresses.

8.name: Ceramic Tiles, Nuts, Steel Forgings, Skateboards
8.overview: Clay is pressed, decorated, glazed and fired into ceramic tiles, edible nuts are harvested and prepared for sale, heated steel is shaped under pressure into strong forged components, and laminated wood decks are formed and fitted with skateboard hardware.

9.name: Car Engines, Flour, Recliners, Envelopes
9.overview: Machined blocks, pistons and other components are assembled into automobile engines, grain is cleaned and milled into flour, frames and reclining mechanisms are padded and upholstered to make recliners, and paper is cut, folded and glued into envelopes.

10.name: Plastic Cups and Cutlery, Special Effects Makeup, Gold, Harps
10.overview: Plastic is thermoformed or molded into disposable cups and cutlery, prosthetics and cosmetics are prepared for special-effects makeup, ore is processed and refined into gold, and carefully selected woods, mechanisms and strings are assembled into harps.

11.name: Countertop Laminate, Frozen Treats, Children's Building Blocks, Detergents
11.overview: Decorative paper and resin are layered and pressed into countertop laminate, flavored mixtures are prepared and frozen into treats, plastic is injection-molded into children’s building blocks, and chemical ingredients are blended and packaged as household detergents.

12.name: Architectural Moldings, Pulleys, Industrial Rubber Hose, Sheet Vinyl Flooring
12.overview: Wood and composite stock are cut into decorative architectural mouldings, metal components are cast and machined into commercial pulleys, reinforced rubber is built into industrial hose, and multiple layers are formed and printed to make sheet vinyl flooring.

13.name: Putty Knives, Garage Doors, Electric Motors, Wool
13.overview: Flexible steel blades are fitted with handles to make putty knives, panels and operating hardware are assembled into garage doors, copper windings and magnetic components are combined into electric motors, and fleece is cleaned, carded and processed into wool fiber.

1.overview: Aggregate and petroleum binder are heated and mixed to make paving asphalt, cookies and marshmallow filling are assembled into chocolate-covered treats, electrical and mechanical components are combined into loudspeakers, and electronic circuitry is installed in programmable door locks.

2.name: Wood Burning Stoves, Orthoses, Ballet Slippers, Buses
2.overview: Heavy steel panels and fire-resistant components are assembled into wood-burning stoves, custom supports are molded into orthoses, fabric and leather are cut and sewn into ballet slippers, and large frames, engines and passenger compartments are assembled into buses.

3.name: Robotic Arms, Tattoos, Sanitary Napkins, Concrete Pipes
3.overview: Motors, joints and computerized controls are assembled into industrial robotic arms, tattoo designs are transferred to skin and applied with electrically driven needles, absorbent materials are layered into sanitary napkins, and reinforced concrete is molded into large pipes.

4.name: Hockey Gloves, Snack Cakes, Remolded Tires, Wastewater Treatment
4.overview: Protective padding, leather and fabric are assembled into hockey gloves, batter and fillings are baked and packaged as snack cakes, worn tire casings receive new tread through remoulding, and municipal wastewater passes through mechanical and biological treatment processes.

5.name: Ambulances, Dining Room Tables, Diatonic Accordions, Acrylic Awards
5.overview: Vehicle bodies are modified and equipped with medical systems to create ambulances, prepared lumber is joined and finished into dining room tables, reeds, bellows and keyboards are assembled into diatonic accordions, and acrylic sheets are cut, engraved and polished into awards.

6.name: Alkaline Batteries, Wheelchairs, Flutes, Cowboy Boots
6.overview: Steel casings are filled with chemical components to make alkaline batteries, metal frames and seating systems are assembled into wheelchairs, metal tubing is shaped and fitted with keys to produce flutes, and leather is cut, stitched and formed into cowboy boots.

7.name: Golf Balls, Furniture Handles, Parking Meters, Room Dividers
7.overview: Synthetic rubber cores and molded covers are formed into golf balls, metal components are cast and finished into furniture handles, timing and payment mechanisms are installed in parking meters, and frames and decorative panels are assembled into room dividers.

8.name: Suits of Armor, Street Light Poles, Bent Hardwood, Membrane Switches
8.overview: Shaped steel plates are fitted together into traditional suits of armour, long sections of metal are formed and finished into street light poles, steamed hardwood is bent around molds, and printed conductive layers are laminated into membrane switches.

9.name: Sulkies, Bagpipes, Yule Logs, Fishing Lures
9.overview: Lightweight frames, shafts and wheels are assembled into sulkies for harness racing, wooden pipes and an airtight bag are combined to make bagpipes, sponge cake and filling are formed into decorative Yule logs, and metal, wood and plastic are shaped into fishing lures.

10.name: Goalie Pads, Lapel Pins, Cardboard Boxes, Crystal Wine Glasses
10.overview: Foam, synthetic materials and protective reinforcements are assembled into hockey goalie pads, stamped metal is decorated and finished into lapel pins, corrugated board is cut and folded into shipping boxes, and molten crystal is blown and shaped into wine glasses.

11.name: Cement, Caskets, Soft Drinks, Glider Rockers
11.overview: Limestone and other minerals are processed into cement, wood or metal shells are lined and finished into caskets, flavored syrup is carbonated and bottled as soft drinks, and upholstered seats are mounted on mechanisms to create glider rockers.

12.name: Kitchen Knives, Mannequins, Socks, Hypodermic Needles
12.overview: Steel blades are stamped, heat-treated and sharpened into kitchen knives, human forms are sculpted and molded into mannequins, yarn is knitted and finished into socks, and stainless-steel tubing is drawn, cut and sharpened into hypodermic needles.

13.name: Electrical Panels, Kites, Eyeglass Frames, Toothbrushes
13.overview: Metal enclosures, circuit breakers and conductive components are assembled into electrical panels, lightweight frames and fabric are combined into kites, metal or plastic is shaped into eyeglass frames, and clusters of nylon bristles are secured in molded toothbrush handles.

1.overview: The production processes behind three-wheeled motor vehicles, wooden baseball bats, artificial bonsai trees and brass trombones are examined.

2.name: Springs, Pavers, Pianos, Rotary Cannons
2.overview: Steel wire is shaped and heat-treated into springs, concrete mixtures are molded into paving stones, thousands of specialized components are assembled and tuned to make pianos, and precision-machined barrels and mechanisms are combined into rotary cannons.

3.name: Ropes, Billiard Tables, Sailboards, Cymbals
3.overview: Individual fibers are twisted together into rope, slate and wooden frames are assembled into billiard tables, lightweight composite materials are formed into sailboards, and metal alloys are hammered and finished into cymbals.

4.name: Seatbelts, Windows, Wax Figurines, Hot Air Balloons
4.overview: Strong woven webbing and locking mechanisms are assembled into automotive seatbelts, glass and frame components are manufactured into windows, wax is molded and detailed into figurines, and large fabric panels are sewn together to create hot-air balloon envelopes.

5.name: Air Filters, Billiard Cues, Ice Sculptures, Suits
5.overview: Filter media is pleated and enclosed to make air filters, selected woods are turned and finished into billiard cues, blocks of ice are carved into decorative sculptures, and fabric is measured, cut and tailored into suits.

6.name: Escalator Handrails, Highlighters, Guitar Strings, Wigs
6.overview: Layers of rubber and reinforcing materials are formed into escalator handrails, fluorescent ink and molded plastic become highlighter pens, metal wire is drawn and wound into guitar strings, and natural or synthetic hair is attached and styled to produce wigs.

7.name: Traditional Bows, Coffee Machines, Mascots, Hammocks
7.overview: Selected woods are shaped and laminated into traditional archery bows, heating and pumping components are assembled into coffee machines, foam and fabric are fashioned into mascot costumes, and strong cords are woven into hammocks.

8.name: Fiberglass Insulation, Wooden Ducks, Gumball Machines, Exhaust Systems
8.overview: Molten glass is spun into fibreglass insulation, wood is carved and painted into decorative ducks, dispensing mechanisms are installed in gumball machines, and formed metal pipes and mufflers are assembled into automotive exhaust systems.

9.name: Chains, Bagels, Vinyl Records
9.overview: Steel rods are bent, welded and heat-treated into chains, rings of yeast dough are boiled and baked into bagels, and recorded audio is transferred to master discs used to press vinyl records.

10.name: Windshields, English Saddles, Butter, Post Clocks
10.overview: Layers of safety glass are shaped and laminated into automotive windshields, leather and supportive frames are crafted into English saddles, cream is churned and processed into butter, and cast housings and clock mechanisms are assembled into traditional post clocks.

11.name: Individual Transporters, Canoes, Electric Guitars
11.overview: Electric motors, sensors and computerized controls are assembled into self-balancing individual transporters, strips of cedar are joined and finished into canoes, and shaped wooden bodies are fitted with pickups and electronics to make electric guitars.

12.name: Residential Water Heaters, Air Bags, Jelly Beans, Ice Resurfacers
12.overview: Insulated tanks and heating systems are assembled into residential water heaters, woven fabric and gas-generating devices become automotive airbags, flavored candy centers receive polished sugar coatings to make jelly beans, and specialized components are installed in machines used to resurface ice rinks.

13.name: Amphibious Vehicles, Putters, Model Ships, Drumheads
13.overview: Watertight bodies and marine propulsion systems are incorporated into amphibious vehicles, metal heads and shafts are assembled into golf putters, miniature components are crafted into detailed model ships, and animal skin or synthetic film is stretched and finished to make drumheads.

1.overview: Leather and synthetic panels are cut and assembled into footballs, electronic components are installed in electric-guitar amplifiers, molten glass is formed into marbles, and laminated wood is shaped and balanced into airplane propellers.

2.name: Engine Blocks, Jawbreakers, Drum Shells, Drums
2.overview: Molten metal is cast and machined into automobile engine blocks, layers of flavored sugar are built up to make jawbreakers, laminated wood is formed into drum shells, and shells, hardware and drumheads are assembled into finished drums.

3.name: Lighters, Fossils, Hockey Pucks, High-Pressure Cylinders
3.overview: Metal and plastic components are assembled into disposable lighters, fossils are carefully exposed and prepared for study or display, rubber is compressed and vulcanized into hockey pucks, and heavy steel is formed and tested to make high-pressure cylinders.

4.name: Balloons, Wallpaper, Frozen French Fries, Incandescent Light Bulbs
4.overview: Liquid latex is molded and cured into balloons, printed paper receives coatings and patterns to become wallpaper, potatoes are cut, partially cooked and frozen into French fries, and glass bulbs, tungsten filaments and electrical contacts are assembled into incandescent lamps.

5.name: Matches, Carousel Horses, Fine Porcelain, Automobile Fuel Tanks
5.overview: Wooden sticks are treated and tipped with combustible compounds to make matches, figures are sculpted and finished into carousel horses, refined clay is shaped, glazed and fired into fine porcelain, and metal or plastic is formed into automotive fuel tanks.

6.name: Glass Cookware, Soap Bars, Steel Drums, Firefighter Uniforms
6.overview: Heat-resistant glass is pressed and tempered into cookware, fats and other ingredients are blended and formed into soap bars, sheet steel is shaped and welded into industrial drums, and flame-resistant fabrics are cut and sewn into firefighter uniforms.

7.name: Crayons, Wooden Kayaks, Lawnmowers, Gold Chains
7.overview: Wax and pigments are blended and molded into crayons, thin wooden strips are joined and finished into kayaks, engines and cutting assemblies are installed in lawn mowers, and gold wire is formed, linked and soldered into chains.

8.name: Inflatable Safety Devices, Braille Typewriters, Carbon-Fiber Cellos
8.overview: Durable coated fabrics are cut and sealed into inflatable safety equipment, specialized keys and embossing mechanisms are assembled into Braille typewriters, and composite materials are molded and finished into carbon-fibre cellos.

9.name: Carbon-Fiber Masts, Fortune Cookies, IMAX Projectors, Roller Chains
9.overview: Layers of carbon fibre are formed and cured into lightweight sailing masts, folded cookies are baked around printed fortunes, large-format optical and mechanical systems are assembled into IMAX projectors, and steel links and pins are combined into roller chains.

10.name: Firefighter Helmets, Nautical Compasses, Packaging Tubes, Hand Saws
10.overview: Impact-resistant shells and protective liners are assembled into firefighter helmets, magnetized components are balanced inside nautical compasses, layers of paperboard are wound into packaging tubes, and steel blades are cut, toothed and fitted with handles to make hand saws.

11.name: Halogen Bulbs, Cellulose Insulation, Aluminum Ladders, Bamboo Fly Rods
11.overview: Quartz envelopes, filaments and halogen gas are combined into light bulbs, recycled paper is treated and processed into cellulose insulation, aluminum rails and rungs are assembled into ladders, and carefully selected bamboo strips are joined and finished into fly-fishing rods.

12.name: Drill Bits, Photo Booths, Stamps
12.overview: Hardened steel is shaped, fluted and sharpened into drill bits, cameras, lighting and printing systems are installed in automated photo booths, and designs are engraved or molded into rubber stamps.

13.name: Yacht Wheels, Braided Rugs, Automobile Thermostats, Chisels
13.overview: Wood is laminated and finished into yacht steering wheels, fabric strips are braided and sewn into rugs, temperature-sensitive components are assembled into automotive thermostats, and steel blades are forged, hardened and sharpened into chisels.

8.name: Season 8

1.name: Photographs, Fur Tanning, Welding Electrodes, Electric Violins
1.overview: Photographic images are developed and printed, animal hides are processed and finished into fur, metal rods receive specialized coatings to become welding electrodes, and traditional instrument-making techniques are combined with electronics to produce electric violins.

2.name: Glass Bottles, Hacksaws, Ice Hockey Goalie Masks
2.overview: Molten glass is molded and cooled into bottles, hardened steel is cut and toothed into hacksaw blades, and layers of composite material are shaped, reinforced and decorated to make protective ice hockey goalie masks.

3.name: Lacrosse Sticks, Frozen Fish Products, Flashlights, Paintbrushes
3.overview: Frames and netting are assembled into lacrosse sticks, fish is prepared and frozen for commercial sale, electrical components are enclosed in portable flashlights, and natural or synthetic bristles are secured into paintbrush handles.

4.name: Deep-Cycle Batteries, Tins, Optical Lenses
4.overview: Lead plates and electrolyte are assembled into rechargeable deep-cycle batteries, sheets of metal are formed and joined into decorative or storage tins, and precisely formulated glass is shaped, ground and polished into optical lenses.

5.name: Horseshoes, Dishwashers, Graphite Fly Rods, Frozen Pizzas
5.overview: Steel is shaped and finished into horseshoes, pumps, racks and controls are assembled into dishwashers, graphite composite material is formed into lightweight fly-fishing rods, and prepared dough, sauce and toppings are assembled and frozen into pizzas.

6.name: Pistons, Paint Rollers, Parachutes, Chimneys
6.overview: Metal blanks are cast or forged and precisely machined into engine pistons, absorbent material is formed around cylindrical paint-roller cores, strong lightweight fabric is cut and sewn into parachutes, and metal sections are shaped and joined into chimney systems.

7.name: CO2 Cartridges, Pretzels, Scissor Lifts, Skating Rinks
7.overview: Small steel cylinders are formed, tested and filled with compressed carbon dioxide, shaped dough is boiled and baked into pretzels, hydraulic systems and crossed supports are assembled into scissor lifts, and layered refrigeration systems create and maintain artificial skating-rink ice.

8.name: Pro Hockey Sticks, Bronzed Baby Shoes, Treadmills, Handheld Computers
8.overview: Composite materials are formed into professional hockey sticks, children’s shoes receive conductive coatings before being electroplated with bronze, motors and moving belts are assembled into treadmills, and compact electronic components are installed in handheld computers.

9.name: Motorcycles, Clay Pipes, Drum Sticks, Whistles
9.overview: Engines, frames and control systems are assembled into motorcycles, clay is molded and fired into smoking pipes, selected wood is shaped and balanced into drumsticks, and metal or plastic components are formed into whistles.

10.name: Handcuffs, Caulking and Joint Compound, Propane Tanks, Forensic Facial Reconstruction
10.overview: Hardened metal components are forged and assembled into handcuffs, chemical ingredients are blended into caulking and joint compound, steel cylinders are formed and tested as propane tanks, and anatomical evidence is used to reconstruct a person’s facial appearance.

11.name: Fur Coats, Hearses, Outdoor Lighting Fixtures, Golf Tees
11.overview: Prepared fur pelts are matched, cut and sewn into coats, production vehicles are lengthened and customized into hearses, weather-resistant components are assembled into outdoor lighting fixtures, and wood or plastic is shaped into golf tees.

12.name: Fishing Reels, Miniature Houses, Kitchen Mixers
12.overview: Gears, spools and housings are assembled into fishing reels, small-scale building materials are crafted into detailed miniature houses, and motors, controls and attachments are combined into kitchen mixers.

13.name: Manhole Covers, Range Hoods, Artificial Logs, Snowmobiles
13.overview: Molten iron is cast into heavy manhole covers, sheet metal and ventilation components are assembled into range hoods, combustible materials are molded into artificial fireplace logs, and engines, tracks and suspension systems are combined into snowmobiles.

9.name: Season 9

1.name: Solid Tires, Cheesecake, Canoe Paddles, Globes
1.overview: Rubber compounds are molded into puncture-resistant solid tires, dairy ingredients are blended and baked into cheesecake, selected wood is shaped and finished into canoe paddles, and printed maps are applied to spherical forms to make globes.

2.name: Boomerangs, Barbeques, Pinball Machines, Strobe Lights
2.overview: Curved pieces of wood are shaped and balanced into returning boomerangs, metal bodies and burners are assembled into outdoor barbecues, mechanical and electronic systems are combined into pinball machines, and electrical components are installed in high-intensity strobe lights.

3.name: Wooden Bowls, Chainsaws, Stackable Potato Chips, Jet Compressor Blades
3.overview: Pieces of hardwood are turned and finished into bowls, engines and cutting chains are assembled into chainsaws, processed potato dough is formed and fried into uniformly stackable chips, and specialized alloys are precisely forged and machined into jet-engine compressor blades.

4.name: Steel Wool, Ranges, Carved Candles, Slot Machines
4.overview: Steel rods are drawn and shaved into fine steel wool, galvanized steel and cooking components are assembled into kitchen ranges, layers of colored wax are cut into decorative candles, and mechanical and electronic parts are installed in slot machines.

5.name: CCD Semiconductors, Airline Meals, Paper Cups, Trumpets
5.overview: Light-sensitive semiconductor components are manufactured for digital imaging devices, prepared dishes are portioned and packaged as airline meals, coated paper is formed and sealed into disposable cups, and brass tubing is shaped and fitted with valves to make trumpets.

6.name: Padlocks, Hair Clippers, Wooden Shoes, Synthetic Leather
6.overview: Laminated steel bodies, shackles and locking mechanisms are assembled into padlocks, electric motors and cutting blades are installed in hair clippers, blocks of poplar are carved into traditional wooden shoes, and textile backing is coated with plastic compounds to create synthetic leather.

7.name: Racing Shells, Stainless Steel Sinks, Leather, Pedal Steel Guitars
7.overview: Lightweight composite materials are formed into racing shells, stainless-steel sheets are pressed and finished into sinks, animal hides are cleaned, softened and tanned into leather, and strings, pedals and mechanical controls are assembled into pedal steel guitars.

8.name: Swords, Pontoons, Grandfather Clocks, Fuses
8.overview: High-carbon steel is cut and finished into replica swords, aluminum sections are formed and welded into boat pontoons, wooden cases and weight-driven movements are assembled into grandfather clocks, and calibrated conductive elements are enclosed in electrical fuses.

9.name: Bumpers, Lighting Gels and Camera Filters, Steam-Powered Models, Candy Canes
9.overview: Formed steel and energy-absorbing materials are assembled into automotive bumpers, dyed polyester is processed into lighting gels and camera filters, miniature boilers and mechanical systems are built into steam-powered models, and cooked sugar is colored, stretched and shaped into candy canes.

10.name: Umbrellas, Outboard Motors, Silver Cutlery, Tape Measures
10.overview: Fabric canopies and collapsible frames are assembled into umbrellas, engines and marine drive systems are combined into outboard motors, sheets of silver are stamped and polished into cutlery, and marked steel strips are installed in retractable tape measures.

11.name: Scalpels, Oil Paints, British Police Helmets, Ice Axes
11.overview: Surgical steel is shaped and sharpened into scalpels, finely ground pigments are combined with oil to make artists’ paint, reinforced plastic and fabric are formed into traditional British police helmets, and aluminum and steel components are shaped into mountaineering ice axes.

12.name: Bacon, Snowblowers, Luxury Cars
12.overview: Pork bellies are cured, flavored, cooked and sliced into bacon, engines and rotating augers are installed in snow blowers, and hand-finished bodies, engines and interiors are assembled into luxury automobiles.

13.name: Automatic Transmissions, Silver Miniatures, Hot Air Balloon Baskets, Darts
13.overview: Gears, clutches and hydraulic controls are assembled inside automatic transmissions, silver is formed and detailed into precisely scaled miniatures, wicker is woven around metal frames to create hot-air-balloon baskets, and metal points, barrels, shafts and flights are assembled into darts.

10.name: Season 10

1.name: Magnets, Cooked Ham, Silver-Plated Teapots, Crash Test Dummies
1.overview: Metal alloys are magnetized and finished into permanent magnets, pork is cured and cooked into ham, formed metal teapots receive a decorative coating of silver, and instrumented human models are assembled for use in automotive crash testing.

2.name: Curling Stones, Refrigerators, Aluminum Baseball Bats, Opalescent Glass
2.overview: Dense granite is cut and polished into curling stones, insulated cabinets and refrigeration systems are assembled into household refrigerators, aluminum tubing is shaped and strengthened into baseball bats, and specialized glass mixtures are formed into opalescent decorative glass.

3.name: Levels, Hot Dogs, Abrasive Grains, Sandpaper
3.overview: Metal or plastic bodies are fitted with calibrated spirit vials to make levels, prepared meat is seasoned and filled into casings to produce hot dogs, minerals are crushed and graded into abrasive grains, and those grains are bonded to flexible backing to manufacture sandpaper.

4.name: Ice Cream Treats, Wooden Golf Clubs, Aircraft Wings, Car Battery Recycling
4.overview: Ice cream is molded and coated to make frozen treats, selected hardwood is shaped and finished into traditional golf clubs, structural components and exterior panels are assembled into aircraft wings, and used automotive batteries are dismantled so their lead, plastic and acid can be recovered.

5.name: Automotive Fuel Pumps, Cricket Bats, Change Machines, Ductile Iron Pipe
5.overview: Electric motors and pumping components are assembled into automotive fuel pumps, willow is pressed, shaped and fitted with handles to make cricket bats, coin-recognition and dispensing mechanisms are installed in change machines, and molten ductile iron is cast into strong pipes.

6.name: Wooden Barrels, Fire Hydrants, Automotive Seats, Cathode Ray Tubes
6.overview: Curved wooden staves are fitted with metal hoops to create barrels, cast metal bodies and valves are assembled into fire hydrants, steel frames, foam and upholstery are combined into automotive seats, and glass envelopes and electron-gun components are manufactured into cathode ray tubes.

7.name: Stainless Steel, Football Helmets, Resin Figurines, Laboratory Glassware
7.overview: Iron is alloyed with chromium and other elements to produce corrosion-resistant stainless steel, molded shells and protective padding are assembled into football helmets, liquid resin is cast and decorated into figurines, and heat-resistant glass tubing is shaped into laboratory equipment.

8.name: Fire Extinguishers, Doughnuts, Shock Absorbers, Banjos
8.overview: Metal cylinders are formed, tested and filled to create fire extinguishers, rings of dough are fried and finished into doughnuts, pistons and hydraulic components are assembled into automotive shock absorbers, and wooden rims, stretched membranes and strings are combined into banjos.

9.name: Dress Forms, Boat Propellers, Duvets, Faucets
9.overview: Molded body sections are covered and mounted to make adjustable dress forms, metal is cast and precisely machined into boat propellers, insulating filling is enclosed in stitched fabric to produce duvets, and cast bodies, valves and handles are assembled into faucets.

10.name: Bronze Bells, Wooden Airplane Propellers, Charcoal Briquettes, Gas Log Fireplaces
10.overview: Molten bronze is cast and tuned into bells, laminated hardwood is shaped and balanced into airplane propellers, powdered charcoal is compressed into uniform briquettes, and ceramic logs, gas burners and control systems are assembled into decorative fireplaces.

11.name: Pocket Knives, Soapstone Products, Electric Pole Transformers, Traditional Snowshoes
11.overview: Steel blades and folding mechanisms are fitted into pocket knives, soft soapstone is cut and polished into decorative and functional objects, electrical windings and insulated cores are assembled into pole-mounted transformers, and wooden frames and woven webbing are fashioned into traditional snowshoes.

12.name: Steel Shipping Drums, Police Whistles, Miniature Train Cars, Glass Blocks
12.overview: Sheet steel is rolled, welded and sealed into shipping drums, metal chambers are formed and tuned into police whistles, small-scale components are molded, painted and assembled into miniature train cars, and pressed sections of molten glass are fused into hollow building blocks.

13.name: Ice Cream Cones, Tent Trailers, Shoe Polish, Pliers
13.overview: Sweet batter is baked and rolled into ice cream cones, collapsible frames and furnished enclosures are installed on trailers for camping, waxes, dyes and solvents are blended into shoe polish, and steel is forged, machined and fitted with grips to make pliers.

11.name: Season 11

1.name: Binoculars, Sparklers, Rubber Boots, Circular Saw Blades
1.overview: Precision lenses and prisms are aligned inside binoculars, metal wire is coated with pyrotechnic material to make sparklers, liquid rubber is molded and vulcanized into waterproof boots, and hardened steel is cut and sharpened into circular saw blades.

2.name: Anatomical Models, Jukeboxes, Tortilla Chips, Spark Plugs
2.overview: Detailed molds and painted components are used to create anatomical teaching models, mechanical and electronic systems are assembled into jukeboxes, corn dough is formed and fried into tortilla chips, and ceramic insulators and metal electrodes are combined into spark plugs.

3.name: Pencils, Metal Recycling, Coffee
3.overview: Graphite cores are enclosed in shaped wooden slats to make pencils, discarded ferrous and non-ferrous metals are sorted and processed for reuse, and coffee beans are roasted, blended and packaged.

4.name: Javelins, Cuckoo Clocks, Hearts of Palm, Windshield Wipers
4.overview: Lightweight materials are shaped and balanced into competition javelins, carved wooden cases and mechanical movements are assembled into cuckoo clocks, cultivated palm stems are harvested and processed into hearts of palm, and rubber blades and articulated frames are combined into windshield wipers.

5.name: Technical Glass, Washing Machines, Playing Cards, Crossbows
5.overview: Specialized glass formulations are heated and molded into durable technical components, drums, pumps and electronic controls are assembled into washing machines, printed sheets are coated and cut into playing cards, and limbs, stocks and trigger mechanisms are fitted together to make crossbows.

6.name: Cine Cameras, Glass Christmas Ornaments, Giant Tires
6.overview: Precision film-transport and optical components are assembled into motion-picture cameras, heated glass is blown, silvered and decorated into Christmas ornaments, and layers of reinforced rubber are built and cured into enormous tires for mining and construction vehicles.

7.name: Microphones, Hot Tubs, Artificial Turf, Beer Steins
7.overview: Sound-sensitive elements and electronic components are enclosed in microphones, heated acrylic shells and plumbing systems are assembled into hot tubs, synthetic fibers are tufted into artificial turf, and molded ceramic bodies are decorated and fitted with pewter lids to make beer steins.

8.name: Hot Rods, Decorative Eggs, Fire Hose Nozzles, Baseballs
8.overview: Classic vehicles are rebuilt with customized bodies and high-performance components to create hot rods, emptied eggshells are intricately decorated, machined valves and controls are assembled into fire-hose nozzles, and layers of yarn, rubber and leather are formed into regulation baseballs.

9.name: Accordions, Pineapples, Artificial Joints
9.overview: Reeds, keyboards, buttons and bellows are assembled into accordions, pineapples are cultivated, tested for ripeness and harvested, and metal and plastic components are manufactured into artificial joints used in replacement surgery.

10.name: Giant Valves, Sardines, Barographs, Disposable Diapers
10.overview: Massive cast and machined components are assembled into industrial flow-control valves, sardines are cleaned and sealed in cans, pressure-sensitive capsules and recording mechanisms are combined into barographs, and absorbent pulp and polymer layers are formed into disposable diapers.

11.name: Heated Skate Blades, Gliders, Hand Bells, Fire Hoses
11.overview: Heating elements and electronic controls are incorporated into skate-blade assemblies, lightweight composite sections are molded into gliders, molten metal is cast and tuned into hand bells, and woven polyester jackets receive flexible inner linings to become fire hoses.

12.name: Induction Cooktops, Truck Scales, Tetra Pak Containers, Harmonicas
12.overview: Electromagnetic coils and electronic controls are installed beneath glass induction cooktops, heavy platforms and load cells are assembled into truck scales, layered packaging material is printed and folded into Tetra Pak containers, and reeds and combs are fitted inside harmonicas.

13.name: Baseball Gloves, Medical Electrodes, Stetson Hats
13.overview: Selected leather is cut, stitched and shaped into baseball gloves, conductive materials and adhesive backings are assembled into disposable medical electrodes, and felt is steamed, formed and finished into traditional Stetson hats.

12.name: Season 12

1.name: Pneumatic Impact Wrenches, Cultured Marble Sinks, Plantain Chips, NASCAR Stock Cars
1.overview: Metal housings, motors and hammer mechanisms are assembled into pneumatic impact wrenches, mineral-filled resin is molded and polished into cultured marble sinks, sliced plantains are fried and seasoned into chips, and specialized frames, engines and safety systems are assembled into NASCAR stock cars.

2.name: Jaws of Life, Artificial Christmas Trees, Soda Crackers, Ratchets
2.overview: Hydraulic pumps and hardened metal tools are assembled into emergency rescue equipment, plastic foliage is attached to metal frames to make artificial Christmas trees, thin sheets of dough are baked into soda crackers, and gears and locking mechanisms are fitted into ratchet handles.

3.name: Thermometers, Produce Scales, Aircraft Painting, Luxury Chocolates
3.overview: Calibrated sensing components are enclosed in thermometers, springs and weighing mechanisms are installed in produce scales, aircraft surfaces are prepared and coated with specialized paint, and premium chocolate is molded, filled and decorated by hand.

4.name: Carburetors, Air Conditioners, Sugar
4.overview: Precisely machined passages, valves and floats are assembled into carburetors, compressors and heat-exchange components are installed in air-conditioning systems, and harvested sugar crops are processed and refined into crystalline sugar.

5.name: Combination Wrenches, Deli Meats, Golf Carts, Airships
5.overview: Steel blanks are forged, machined and plated into combination wrenches, prepared meats are seasoned, cooked and sliced for delicatessen sale, electric drive systems and molded bodies are assembled into golf cars, and lightweight structures and fabric envelopes are combined into airships.

6.name: Carbon Fibre Car Parts, Hand Dryers, Recycled Polyester Yarn, Fleece
6.overview: Layers of carbon fibre are molded and cured into lightweight automotive components, heating elements and blowers are installed in electric hand dryers, discarded plastic is processed and spun into recycled polyester yarn, and synthetic fabric is brushed and finished into fleece.

7.name: Police Badges, Muffins, Car Washes, Pressure Gauges
7.overview: Metal blanks are stamped, plated and finished into police badges, measured batter is deposited and baked into muffins, automated spraying and brushing systems are assembled for commercial car washes, and pressure-sensitive mechanisms are calibrated inside gauges.

8.name: Metal Detectors, Rum, Tiffany Reproductions, Aircraft Engines
8.overview: Electronic coils and control circuits are assembled into metal detectors, fermented sugar-cane products are distilled and aged into rum, colored glass is cut and joined into Tiffany-style reproductions, and precision components are manufactured and assembled into aircraft engines.

9.name: Riding Mowers, Popcorn, Adjustable Beds, Cultured Diamonds
9.overview: Engines, cutting decks and controls are assembled into riding lawn mowers, heated kernels expand into popcorn, powered frames and articulated supports are installed in adjustable beds, and laboratory processes reproduce the conditions needed to grow cultured diamonds.

10.name: Airstream Trailers, Horseradish, Industrial Steam Boilers, Deodorant
10.overview: Curved aluminum panels and fitted interiors are assembled into Airstream travel trailers, horseradish roots are cleaned, ground and prepared as a condiment, heavy steel vessels and burner systems are combined into industrial steam boilers, and active ingredients are blended and packaged as deodorant.

11.name: Screwdrivers, Compact Track Loaders, Physician Scales, Carbon Fibre Bats
11.overview: Hardened steel shafts are shaped and fitted with handles to make screwdrivers, diesel engines and hydraulic systems are assembled into compact track loaders, calibrated weighing mechanisms are installed in physician scales, and composite materials are layered and cured into carbon fibre baseball bats.

12.name: Escalators, Kevlar Canoes, Goat Cheese, Disc Music Boxes
12.overview: Linked steps, drive chains and safety systems are assembled into escalators, layers of Kevlar fabric and resin are molded into lightweight canoes, cultured goat milk is processed and aged into cheese, and pinned metal discs operate the mechanisms inside disc music boxes.

13.name: Motorcycle Engines, Glass Enamel Sculptures, Hand-Made Paper, Vaulting Poles
13.overview: Precision-machined parts are assembled into motorcycle engines, powdered glass enamel is applied and fused into decorative sculptures, plant fibres are pulped and formed into handmade paper, and layers of composite material are shaped and tested to produce flexible vaulting poles.

13.name: Season 13

1.name: Hammers, Swiss Cheese, Roller Skates, Coloured Pencils
1.overview: Steel heads are forged and fitted with handles to make hammers, cultured milk is processed and aged into Swiss cheese, boots are mounted on wheeled frames to create roller skates, and coloured cores are enclosed in shaped wooden casings to make pencils.

2.name: Carbon Fiber Bicycles, Blood Products, Forged Chandeliers, Ballpoint Pens
2.overview: Carbon-fiber layers are molded and cured into lightweight bicycle frames, donated blood is separated into medical products, heated metal is forged and assembled into chandeliers, and ink reservoirs and writing tips are installed in ballpoint pens.

3.name: Swiss Army Knives, Player Piano Rolls, Oil Tankers, Racing Wheels
3.overview: Blades and folding implements are assembled into Swiss Army knives, paper rolls are perforated to control player pianos, large steel sections and storage tanks are assembled into oil tankers, and lightweight metal is formed and finished into racing wheels.

4.name: Bowling Balls, Barber Poles, Felt, Radar Guns
4.overview: Resin and weighted cores are molded and polished into bowling balls, illuminated rotating cylinders are assembled into barber poles, compressed fibers are processed into felt, and microwave components are calibrated inside radar guns.

5.name: Copper Pipe Fittings, Cylinder Music Boxes, Pepper Mills, Hot Rod Steering Columns
5.overview: Copper tubing is shaped into plumbing fittings, pinned cylinders and tuned metal combs are assembled into music boxes, grinding mechanisms are enclosed in pepper mills, and shafts and articulated joints are assembled into custom hot-rod steering columns.

6.name: Gears, Leather Watchbands, Vitrelle Dishes, Kitchen Shears
6.overview: Metal blanks are cut and finished into precision gears, prepared leather is shaped and stitched into watchbands, laminated glass is molded and strengthened into Vitrelle dishes, and hardened blades and handles are assembled into kitchen shears.

7.name: Pressure Cookers, Mechanical Singing Birds, Oceanographic Buoys, Tank Trailers
7.overview: Locking lids and pressure-control valves are fitted to pressure cookers, miniature mechanisms animate mechanical singing birds, scientific instruments are installed in oceanographic buoys, and stainless-steel tanks are fabricated and mounted on transport trailers.

8.name: Aluminum Boats, Alpine Horns, Luxury Watches
8.overview: Aluminum sheets and structural supports are formed and welded into boats, selected wood is hollowed and shaped into long Alpine horns, and precision movements, cases, dials and hands are assembled into luxury watches.

9.name: All-Terrain Vehicles, Alpine Skis, Laser Cutters, Marble Sculptures
9.overview: Engines, frames and suspension systems are assembled into all-terrain vehicles, laminated materials are shaped and finished into Alpine skis, optical and mechanical systems are combined into industrial laser cutters, and stone is carved and polished into marble sculptures.

10.name: Socket Sets, Leather Shoes, Aluminum Water Bottles, Bike Chains
10.overview: Hardened steel is forged and machined into sockets and ratchets, prepared leather is cut and formed into shoes, aluminum blanks are shaped into reusable water bottles, and steel links, pins and rollers are assembled into bicycle chains.

11.name: Carved Wood Sculptures, Flatware, Cow Bells, Fountain Pens
11.overview: Blocks of wood are carved and detailed into sculptures, metal blanks are stamped and polished into flatware, formed sheet metal is assembled and tuned into cow bells, and ink reservoirs, feeds and nibs are fitted into fountain pens.

12.name: Olive Oil, Lift Trucks, Seamless Rolled Rings, Ski Boots
12.overview: Harvested olives are crushed and separated into olive oil, engines and hydraulic lifting systems are assembled into lift trucks, heated metal blanks are rolled into seamless rings, and rigid shells, liners and fastening systems are combined into ski boots.

13.name: Professional Cookware, Luxury Inlaid Boxes, High-Efficiency Water Heaters, Scooters
13.overview: Layers of metal are formed and finished into professional cookware, decorative veneers are cut and fitted into luxury inlaid boxes, insulated tanks and efficient heating systems are assembled into water heaters, and engines, frames and body panels are combined into scooters.

1.name: Ski Goggles, Tower Cranes, Porcelain Figurines, Diesel Engines
1.overview: Protective lenses are formed, tinted and coated before being fitted into flexible ski-goggle frames. The episode also follows the fabrication and assembly of towering construction cranes, the casting and hand-decoration of porcelain figurines, and the precision machining and assembly required to build powerful diesel engines.

2.name: Mini GP Motorcycles, Fig Cookies, Tool Boxes, Pipe Bends
2.overview: Compact racing motorcycles take shape as their lightweight frames, engines, suspension and controls are assembled. Fig filling is enclosed in sheets of dough and baked into uniform cookies, sheet metal is cut and folded into durable tool boxes, and straight tubing is formed into accurate bends without crushing or distorting its walls.

3.name: Western Revolver Replicas, Arc Trainers, Used-Oil Furnaces, Vegetable Peelers and Pizza Cutters
3.overview: Metal components are cast, machined and finished to create non-firing replicas of historic Western revolvers. The episode also reveals how elliptical arc trainers combine steel frames with resistance mechanisms, how furnaces convert used lubricating oil into heat, and how sharpened stainless-steel parts become vegetable peelers and rolling pizza cutters.

4.name: Custom Running Shoes, Axes, Racing Karts, Animatronics
4.overview: Measurements of a runner’s feet and movement are used to create individually fitted shoes, with custom-shaped components joined to supportive uppers and soles. Axe heads are forged, heat-treated, sharpened and mounted on handles; racing karts are assembled around welded chassis and compact engines; and animatronic characters combine sculpted outer forms with internal mechanical and electronic systems.

5.name: Metal Golf Clubs, Waffles, Custom Wires and Cables, Train Wheels
5.overview: Golf-club heads are cast or forged, shaped and fitted to carefully selected shafts. Waffle batter is portioned and baked between patterned cooking plates, electrical conductors are drawn, stranded and insulated to produce custom cables, and massive steel blanks are forged and machined into train wheels capable of supporting heavy rail vehicles.

6.name: Sails, Walnuts, Wheel Immobilizers, Honeycomb Structural Panels
6.overview: Computer-designed fabric panels are cut, joined and reinforced to create sails able to withstand changing wind loads. Walnuts are cracked, separated and graded, hardened metal components are assembled into vehicle wheel immobilizers, and lightweight honeycomb cores are bonded between rigid outer skins to form exceptionally strong structural panels.

7.name: Surfboards, Stickers, Sandwich Cookies, Concrete Roofing Tiles
7.overview: Foam blanks are shaped into surfboards before being reinforced with fibreglass and resin and given a smooth final finish. Printed designs receive adhesive and protective coatings before being cut into stickers, baked cookie halves are paired around measured portions of filling, and coloured concrete is moulded and cured into durable roofing tiles.

8.name: Stuffed Olives, Astrolabes, Western Saddles
8.overview: Olives are sorted, pitted and filled before being preserved and packaged. Metal discs are engraved and assembled into working astrolabes based on traditional astronomical instruments, while Western saddles are built around rigid trees and completed with shaped padding, fitted leather and decorative tooling.

9.name: Headphones, Diving Regulators, Reflector Light Bulbs
9.overview: Miniature speaker drivers, wiring and cushioned housings are assembled into headphones. Precision valves, diaphragms and seals are combined and pressure-tested to create diving regulators, while reflector bulbs are formed, coated and fitted with their electrical components to concentrate light into a controlled beam.

10.name: Fly Fishing Reels, House Paint, Weaving Looms, Ice Makers
10.overview: Lightweight metal is machined into precisely balanced fly-fishing reels and fitted with smooth drag mechanisms. Pigments, binders and additives are blended into house paint, weaving looms coordinate warp and weft threads to produce patterned fabric, and automatic ice makers freeze water, release the finished cubes and prepare for the next cycle.

11.name: Graphite Pencil Leads, Clarinets, Special Effects
11.overview: Graphite and clay are blended, extruded into slender rods, fired and treated to produce smooth, durable pencil leads. Seasoned wood is drilled, turned and fitted with a complex key mechanism to make clarinets, while special-effects artists use sculpting, mould-making, flexible materials and mechanical devices to create convincing physical illusions.

12.name: Air Boats, Onions, 3D Metal Printing, Curved Cabinet Doors
12.overview: A flat-bottomed hull, powerful engine, large propeller and protective cage are combined to build an airboat capable of crossing shallow water and marshland. Onions are harvested, cured, graded and packed; metal powder is fused layer by layer from a digital design; and glued layers of wood are pressed over shaped forms to produce curved cabinet doors.

13.name: Retractable Ballpoint Pens, Solar Salt, Tubas
13.overview: Injection-moulded pen bodies are fitted with ink refills, ballpoint tips, springs and retracting mechanisms. Salt water is concentrated in large evaporation ponds until crystals can be harvested and refined, while sheets and tubes of brass are shaped, joined and polished into the long air passages and broad bell of a tuba.

1.name: Kelp Caviar, Luxury Sailboats, Dental Crowns, High-Performance Engines
1.overview: Dried kelp is ground and blended into a gel before being formed into caviar-like pearls and packaged in a variety of flavours. Fibreglass hulls, decks and hand-finished interiors are assembled into luxury sailboats; digital models guide the production of ceramic dental crowns; and precision-machined components are combined and tested in high-performance engines.

2.name: Leather Briefcases, Crop Dusters, Corn Whiskey, Drag Racing Clutches
2.overview: Bridle leather is cut, reinforced, hand-stitched and fitted with polished hardware to create traditional briefcases. Welded airframes, chemical hoppers and spray systems are assembled into crop-dusting aircraft; ground corn is fermented and distilled into whiskey; and machined plates, friction discs, springs and levers become drag-racing clutches.

3.name: Train Rails, Desalinated Water, Racing Wheelchairs, Parquetry
3.overview: Recycled steel is melted, cast and rolled into long sections of train rail before being straightened and inspected. Seawater passes through filtration and high-pressure membrane systems to become drinking water; lightweight tubing is shaped around an athlete’s measurements to build a racing wheelchair; and precisely cut hardwood pieces are arranged into decorative parquet flooring.

4.name: Flight Simulators, Bookbinding, Greenhouse Tomatoes, Hurricane-Proof Shutters
4.overview: Cockpit controls, computer-generated displays and motion systems are integrated into realistic flight simulators. Printed sheets are folded, sewn and enclosed in handcrafted covers using traditional bookbinding methods; tomatoes are cultivated under carefully regulated greenhouse conditions; and reinforced shutters are fabricated and tested to protect windows from hurricane-force winds and flying debris.

5.name: Worcestershire Sauce, Lawn Bowls, Radio-Controlled Model Jets
5.overview: A complex mixture of seasonings and fermented ingredients is matured, filtered and bottled as Worcestershire sauce. Dense synthetic blanks are shaped, weighted and polished to give lawn bowls their distinctive curved path, while lightweight composite airframes, radio-control equipment and miniature turbine engines are assembled into high-performance model jets.

6.name: Pipes, Rock Climbing Gear, Leather Bike Saddles, Luxury Sports Cars
6.overview: Fire-resistant briar wood is drilled, carved, stained and fitted with a vulcanite mouthpiece to create a smoking pipe. Aircraft-grade aluminum is forged and heat-treated into carabiners and other climbing equipment; wet leather is moulded over a metal bicycle-saddle frame; and lightweight chassis, powerful drivetrains and carefully finished body panels come together in luxury sports cars.

7.name: Replica Foods, Traffic Cone Dispensers, Rocking Horses, London Taxis
7.overview: Real dishes are used to make silicone moulds from which durable plastic replica foods are cast, trimmed and hand-painted. Welded frames, motors and robotic arms form machines that deploy and retrieve traffic cones; hardwood pieces are carved and joined into traditional rocking horses; and purpose-built bodies, drivetrains and passenger compartments are assembled into London taxis.

8.name: Miniature Furniture, Garden Steam Locomotives, Hovercraft, Folding Bicycles
8.overview: Craftspeople reproduce the joinery, upholstery and finishes of full-sized furniture in miniature. Precision-machined boilers, cylinders and running gear become working garden steam locomotives; lightweight hulls, flexible skirts and propulsion fans are assembled into hovercraft; and hinged frames with secure locking mechanisms allow bicycles to fold into compact packages.

9.name: Crosscut Saws, Haggis, Collectible Firearms
9.overview: Steel blades are cut, toothed, hardened and sharpened to produce crosscut saws capable of slicing cleanly across wood grain. Organ meats, oatmeal, onions and seasonings are prepared and packed into traditional haggis, while machined metal components and carefully fitted wooden stocks are finished and assembled into collectible firearms.

10.name: Alligator Bags, Lockers, Bench Planes, Deployable Flight Recorders
10.overview: Selected alligator hides are cut, reinforced, stitched and finished into luxury handbags. Sheet metal is punched, folded and joined to make storage lockers; cast bodies, sharpened blades and shaped handles become woodworking bench planes; and protected recording units are enclosed in deployable housings designed to preserve aircraft data after an accident.

11.name: Grapples, Flavorings, Dog Sleds, Athletic Shoes
11.overview: Heavy steel parts are cut, welded and fitted with hydraulic mechanisms to create industrial grapples. Natural and synthetic ingredients are extracted, measured and blended into concentrated food flavourings; shaped wooden components are joined and reinforced to build dog sleds; and layers of fabric, foam, rubber and supportive materials are cut, stitched and bonded into athletic shoes.

12.name: Retractable Cords, Wood Frame Sports Cars, Sushi
12.overview: Insulated electrical conductors are wound around forms and heat-treated so they repeatedly return to their compact coiled shape. Traditional timber frameworks are shaped and joined before receiving metal body panels and mechanical components in wood frame sports cars, while seasoned rice, seafood, vegetables and seaweed are carefully prepared and assembled into sushi.

13.name: Leather Wallets, French Horns, Soy Sauce, Children's Ride-On Cars
13.overview: Leather is cut, thinned, lined and stitched into wallets with precisely fitted pockets and compartments. Brass tubing is bent, joined and equipped with valves and a flared bell to create French horns; fermented soybeans and wheat are aged, pressed and filtered into soy sauce; and moulded bodies, electric motors, batteries and controls are assembled into children’s ride-on cars.

1.name: Millefiori Glass Paperweights, Road Salt, Nutcrackers, Car Doors
1.overview: Slices of brightly patterned glass cane are arranged and fused within clear glass to create millefiori paperweights. The episode also follows the processing of road salt for winter de-icing, the carving and assembly of traditional character nutcrackers, and the stamping, welding and fitting of steel panels to produce complete car doors.

2.name: Straight Razors, Black Pudding, Steering Wheels, Inorganic Pigments
2.overview: Steel blanks are shaped, hardened, ground and carefully honed into straight razors. Blood, fat, grain and seasonings are prepared for traditional black pudding; metal frames are padded, covered and equipped to become steering wheels; and mineral ingredients are processed into stable inorganic pigments used to colour manufactured products.

3.name: Cast Iron Cookware, Biodiesel, Clothes Hangers, Stone Wool Insulation
3.overview: Molten iron is poured into moulds, cleaned and finished to create durable cast iron cookware. Vegetable oil is chemically converted and purified into biodiesel, clothes hangers are shaped and assembled for strength and balance, and molten rock is spun into fibres before being compressed into fire-resistant stone wool insulation.

4.name: Needles and Pins, Architectural Mouldings, Locomotives, Clothespins
4.overview: Fine metal wire is straightened, cut, pointed and finished to manufacture needles and pins. Decorative profiles are reproduced as architectural mouldings, heavy structural and mechanical systems are assembled into working locomotives, and shaped wooden pieces are joined with metal springs to produce clothespins.

5.name: Filigree Glass, Fish Food, Motor Homes
5.overview: Fine strands and rods of coloured glass are heated, arranged and fused into the intricate patterns of filigree glass. Nutritional ingredients are ground, blended and formed into fish food, while a vehicle chassis receives insulated walls, utilities, furnishings and fitted interiors to become a self-contained motor home.

6.name: Surgical Instruments, Ketchup, Double-Decker Buses, Walking Sticks
6.overview: Medical-grade steel is forged or machined, polished and inspected to create precise surgical instruments. Tomatoes are cooked, strained, seasoned and bottled as ketchup; large chassis and body sections are assembled into double-decker buses; and selected wood is straightened, shaped and finished into walking sticks.

7.name: Audio Vacuum Tubes, Light Bars, Wood Model Aircraft, Metal Snare Drums
7.overview: Delicate electrodes and control grids are assembled inside glass envelopes that are evacuated and sealed to form audio vacuum tubes. Optical modules, wiring and housings are combined into emergency light bars; lightweight wooden pieces are cut and joined into model aircraft; and formed metal shells are fitted with heads, tensioning hardware and snare wires to create snare drums.

8.name: Kitchen Accessories, Central Vacuums, Papier-Mâché Animals, Hydraulic Cylinders
8.overview: Metal, wood and plastic components are shaped and finished into practical kitchen accessories. Motors, filters and collection housings are assembled into central vacuum systems; layers of paper and adhesive are moulded, dried and painted as papier-mâché animals; and precision tubes, rods, pistons and seals are combined into hydraulic cylinders.

9.name: Clay Liquor Jugs, Poultry Deli Meats, NASCAR Engines
9.overview: Clay is formed into traditional liquor jugs before the vessels are dried, glazed and fired. Poultry is prepared, seasoned, formed and cooked into uniform deli meats, while specially machined blocks, cylinder heads and internal components are assembled and tested as high-output NASCAR racing engines.

10.name: Digital Dentistry, Nail Clippers, Poster Restoration, Canola Oil
10.overview: Digital scans and computer-guided equipment are used to design and manufacture precisely fitted dental restorations. Steel is stamped, hardened, sharpened and assembled into nail clippers; damaged posters are cleaned, flattened, repaired and reinforced; and canola seeds are cleaned, crushed and refined into cooking oil.

11.name: Dial Thermometers, Hummus, Spent Fuel Containers, Straw Sombreros
11.overview: Temperature-sensitive mechanisms are connected to calibrated faces and protective housings to produce dial thermometers. Cooked chickpeas are blended with tahini, oil and seasonings to make hummus; heavy engineered components are fabricated into shielded containers for spent nuclear fuel; and straw is woven, shaped and trimmed into traditional sombreros.

12.name: Tequila, Waterbeds, Flip Flops, Silver
12.overview: Blue agave hearts are cooked, crushed, fermented and distilled to produce tequila. Sheets of flexible vinyl are cut, heat-sealed and fitted with valves to form waterbed mattresses; moulded soles and straps are assembled into flip-flops; and silver-bearing material is refined, melted and cast into usable forms.

13.name: Composite Propane Cylinders, Salsa, Water-Pumping Windmills, Dragsters
13.overview: Lightweight liners are wrapped with resin-impregnated fibres, cured and pressure-tested to create composite propane cylinders. Vegetables and seasonings are cleaned, chopped, blended and packaged as salsa; galvanized steel components are assembled into windmills that operate mechanical water pumps; and reinforced chassis, powerful engines and specialized drivetrains are combined into dragsters.

1.name: Decorative Sombreros, Salad Dressings & Marinades, Cap Guns, Regenerative Medicine
1.overview: Traditional hat bodies are shaped into broad-brimmed sombreros before receiving decorative trim and detailed embroidery. Oils, vinegars and seasonings are blended into salad dressings and marinades; moulded toy components are assembled into cap guns; and regenerative-medicine researchers combine living cells with supportive structures to produce replacement tissue.

2.name: Cheese Graters, Hot Sauce, Silver Jewellery, Traditional Mexican Chairs
2.overview: Stainless-steel sheets are perforated, sharpened and formed into cheese graters. Peppers and seasonings are processed into bottled hot sauce, silver is shaped, joined and polished into jewellery, and wooden frameworks with leather seating are handcrafted into traditional Mexican chairs known as equipales.

3.name: Game Calls, Mayonnaise, Traditional Razor Blades, Butterfly Safety Razors
3.overview: Reeds and resonating chambers are carefully shaped to produce game calls that imitate wild animals. Oil, eggs and acidic ingredients are emulsified into mayonnaise; thin steel is hardened, ground and coated to make razor blades; and precision components are assembled into butterfly-opening safety razors.

4.name: Corn Tortillas, Crankshafts & Camshafts, Bush Planes, Aluminum Bike Wheels
4.overview: Prepared corn dough is portioned, flattened and baked into tortillas. Engine components are forged or cast before being machined and hardened into crankshafts and camshafts; rugged airframes are equipped for bush flying; and aluminium rims, hubs and spokes are assembled into lightweight bicycle wheels.

5.name: Folding Kayaks, Piñatas, Garbage Trucks, Ceramic Composite Brake Discs
5.overview: Sectional frameworks and waterproof skins are fitted together to create kayaks that collapse for transportation. Paper and cardboard forms are decorated as piñatas, commercial truck chassis receive hydraulically operated refuse bodies and compactors, and fibre-reinforced materials are heated and machined into high-performance ceramic composite brake discs.

6.name: Rolled Wafers, Wood Pellets, Class & Championship Rings
6.overview: Thin layers of batter are baked and rolled while still warm to produce crisp wafer tubes. Dried wood residue is ground and compressed into dense heating pellets, while cast precious-metal blanks are polished, engraved and fitted with stones to create class and championship rings.

7.name: Speed Skates, Synthetic Rubber, Cocoa Beans, Bulk Chocolate
7.overview: Supportive boots are fitted with long, carefully aligned blades to create speed skates. Chemical ingredients are polymerized and compounded into synthetic rubber, cocoa beans are fermented and dried after harvesting, and roasted beans are ground, refined and blended into bulk chocolate.

8.name: Custom Steering Wheels, Aerospace Fuel Lines, Apple Pies, Household Radiators
8.overview: Metal steering-wheel frames are padded, shaped and hand-covered to suit individual vehicles. Aerospace tubing is bent, fitted and pressure-tested for use as fuel lines; pastry shells are filled and baked into apple pies; and pressed metal panels are welded and finished as household radiators.

9.name: Whips, Automated Pizza Makers, Incense Cones, Scale Turbine Engines
9.overview: Strips of leather are tapered and tightly braided into flexible whips. Automated machines portion dough, sauce and toppings to prepare pizzas; aromatic powders and binders are moulded and dried into incense cones; and miniature compressor and turbine components are machined, balanced and assembled into working scale engines.

10.name: Heather Gems, Instant Film, Beet Sugar, Electric Roadsters
10.overview: Dried heather stems are dyed, bundled with resin and compressed into patterned blocks that can be cut and polished into jewellery. Photosensitive layers and chemical pods are combined into instant film, sugar is extracted and crystallized from sliced beets, and battery packs and electric drivetrains are installed in lightweight roadsters.

11.name: Underwater Robots, Lasagne, Band Saws, Ski & Trekking Poles
11.overview: Waterproof housings, cameras, thrusters and electronic controls are assembled into remotely operated underwater robots. Pasta sheets are layered with sauces and fillings to produce lasagne; toothed steel strips are welded into continuous band-saw blades; and lightweight tubes receive grips, baskets and hardened tips to become ski and trekking poles.

12.name: Laminated Wood Beams, Sport Utility Vehicles, Veggie Burgers, Wood Boring Augers
12.overview: Selected lengths of timber are coated with structural adhesive, stacked and pressed into strong laminated beams. Vehicle bodies, drivetrains and interiors are assembled into sport utility vehicles; plant-based ingredients are mixed and formed into veggie burgers; and spiral steel flights are shaped and attached to shafts to create wood-boring augers.

13.name: Turbochargers, Enchiladas, Watches
13.overview: Precision-machined compressor and turbine wheels are balanced and installed inside heat-resistant housings to create turbochargers. Tortillas are filled, rolled and covered with sauce to prepare enchiladas, while tiny gears, springs, dials and cases are assembled and regulated to produce mechanical watches.

1.name: Patterned Glass Panels, Road Cases, Stop-Frame Animation
1.overview: Molten glass is formed with textured patterns to create decorative and privacy panels. Durable plywood shells are reinforced with metal edging, corners and locking hardware to make protective road cases, while models and sets are moved in tiny increments and photographed one frame at a time to produce stop-frame animation.

2.name: Industrial Wire Ropes, Living Walls, Large Format Cameras, Gemstones
2.overview: Individual steel wires are twisted into strands and wound around a central core to produce heavy-duty industrial wire ropes. Plants, growing media and irrigation systems are combined into vertical living walls; precision bodies, bellows and film holders are assembled into large-format cameras; and rough gemstones are cut and polished to reveal their colour and pattern.

3.name: Chocolate Coins, Floor Heating Systems, Pedal Cars, Latex Swords
3.overview: Tempered chocolate is moulded into coins and wrapped in embossed metallic foil. Electrical heating elements are arranged beneath flooring to provide even radiant heat, child-sized pedal cars are assembled from shaped body and drive components, and flexible theatrical swords are cast in moulds and finished with layers of coloured latex.

4.name: Farmed Caviar, Intake Manifolds, Motorcycle Jackets, Shovels & Spades
